title: Symbiosis: A Human–AI Co-Reflection Architecture Using Graph–Vector Memory for Long-Horizon Thinking
abstract: Symbiosis presents a human–AI co-reflection architecture that couples large language models with a hybrid memory substrate—Neo4j for knowledge graphs, Qdrant for vector search—and a unified API with structured reflection/logging. The system is designed to enable persistent, traceable, and metacognitively informed long-horizon reasoning, demonstrated through multi-year Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) research use.
